exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
exercises.notes: UP to 22.5kg (from 20kg). Last was 12/12/12 @ RPE 7 - clearest room on the day. If reps land at 9-10 that's fine, 22.5 becomes the new baseline.

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.notes: HOLD 52.5kg. Last was 10/10/10 @ RPE 8 - technically earned +2.5, but it has been 23 days since you last squatted. Requalify the load today, add 2.5kg next Day C. High box, controlled depth, KNEE CAUTION. Warm up with 2 light ramp sets.

exercises.name: Cable Row
exercises.notes: UP to 52.5kg (from 50kg). Last was 12/12/12 @ RPE 8. Chest up, no torso swing - lower back is the priority.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: HOLD 10kg per hand. Unilateral + knee history + 23-day layoff on this movement = hold, don't load. Controlled, front knee tracking over mid-foot.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: HOLD 45kg. This machine only scales in 5kg steps, and you were already at RPE 9 on 45 - a jump to 50 is too big. 45 is the real baseline (the old 42.5 target was wrong).

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: HOLD 15kg, reps capped at 10 - your own call from last time: form breaks down at 12 with the 15s. Clean 10/10/10 beats 12/10/8.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: ONE triple-drop, no rest: 30kg to failure -> 25kg to failure -> 20kg to failure. Last was 11/5/5. Optional 4th drop to 15kg if you have time, like you did on 2026-07-03.

session_notes: First Day C in 23 days - the legs and lats work here is the least recently trained in the program, so form quality beats load. Two weights up (incline DB, cable row) where RPE was 7-8 with all reps; everything else holds to requalify after the layoff. Extra warm-up on Box Squat and Bulgarian - knee and lower back both need it after the gap.
